clips.title: The story
paras: At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten is after Witherbark tusks, medicine pouches and a shadow hunter's knife, all reagents for Archmage Malin, who sent him and Skuerto to gather them. He asks you to seek them among the Witherbark trolls in the southeast of Arathi.

Archmage Malin sent Kryten and Skuerto to Arathi to collect reagents, and Kryten had no idea how to gather them until you arrived. He needs ten Witherbark tusks, four medicine pouches and one shadow hunter knife. The Witherbark trolls make their home in the southeast of Arathi.

By Kryten's research, any Witherbark troll should have tusks, and the witch doctors carry the medicine pouches. The knife belongs to the mightiest shadow hunters, handed to them after they finish their rites of passage. Only battle will show which of them has one.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Archmage Malin sent Skuerto and I here to collect reagents for him. I was at a loss as to how I was going to collect the items, but now that you're here, I think my problem's solved.
I need the following: Witherbark tusks, Witherbark medicine pouches and a shadow hunter knife.
Could you find those for me? The Witherbark live to the southeast of Arathi.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you had any luck so far, friend?

If my research is correct, the tusks should come from any Witherbark troll. The medicine pouches come from the Witherbark witch doctors, and the strongest of the Witherbark shadow hunters should carry the special knife given to them after they've completed their rites of passage. There's no way to tell which shadow hunters will have the knife until you do battle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Incredible! I can see why Malin asked you to come join us--very well done indeed!
At this rate, Skuerto and I will be headed back to Stormwind in no time at all.
I believe my dwarven companion is back from scouting Boulderfist Hall; go speak to him when you're ready.
It looked as though he might have had a bit of a scuffle with the ogres. Don't mention that to him, though; he's very sensitive about criticisms to his skills at scouting.
